stemMd: Which inference about the app is supported?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It recruited only expert rural observers.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It reduced the number of submitted sightings.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It changed the observation process as well as the number of reports.

explanationMd: Simplified submission and new recruitment alter how observations are collected. Those process changes are sufficient to complicate interpretation of the increased count.

distractorRationale.a: The passage emphasises new town participants.
